source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1022 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1022 was established by Ordinance No. 31385, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 13, 2019. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1022 is established on property located at the south corner of Colorado Boulevard and Anniels Drive. The size of PD 1022 is approximately 0.7499 acre. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 1022A: development/landscape plan. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Development/Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.105. DEVELOPMENT/LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 1022A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District only by specific

use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the TH-3(A) Townhouse District apply.

(b) Residential uses.

(1) Front yard.

(A) Minimum front yard. No minimum front yard.

(B) Maximum front yard. Maximum front yard is 15 feet.

(C) Setback area. A minimum of 50 percent of the cumulative frontage area between the minimum and maximum setback must contain a building.

(2) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(3) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 14.

(4) Height. Maximum structure height is 55 feet.

(5) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 80 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not. For single family structures, a shared access easement may be counted towards the lot in calculating lot coverage.

(6) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(7) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is four. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A- 4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) A residential use within 20 feet of a street may not have a garage door facing the front lot line. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Landscaping And Urban Forest Conservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.111. LANDSCAPING AND URBAN FOREST CONSERVATION.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development/landscape plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) If a protected tree in the parkway shown on the development/landscape plan is removed, it must be replaced with an approved large tree species. This provision applies only to the four protected trees in the parkway that are shown on the development/landscape plan that are located outside the visibility triangle.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Fences For Shared Access Developments
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.113. FENCES FOR SHARED ACCESS DEVELOPMENTS.

(a) Fence height. Maximum fence height is six feet within 15 feet of Colorado Boulevard and four feet within 15 feet of Anniels Drive.

(B) Fence openness. Fences within 15 feet of a street must be a minimum of 50 percent open. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Sidewalks And Pedestrian Amenities
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.114. SIDEWALKS AND PEDESTRIAN AMENITIES.

(a) A minimum six-foot-wide unobstructed sidewalk is required in the right-of-way.

(b) One bicycle rack and one bench must be located on the Property adjacent to the right-of-way sidewalk. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31385)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1022.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31385)
